body:
Founder reported not seeing an animations/rig browser. Verified live: the feature IS deployed (grepped the actual built JS bundle for the expected labels) -- real discoverability gap, not a missing feature. Added filter tabs (All/Meshes/Rigs/Animations/Needs animation, each with a live count) over the existing unified Animations tab data, giving a real 'browser' feel without splitting into separate pages/data models. tsc/build clean, labels confirmed in the rebuilt bundle, redeployed. Commit 97ddc40.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK Animations tab -- filterable Mesh/Rig/Animation views (discoverability fix)
